svg.title: Corrosion Mechanisms
svg.desc: Four interacting contributors: electrochemical corrosion in conductive water, chloride/sulphide attack on passive films; acidic species associated with CO₂/H₂S; oxygen ingress and differential-aeration/crevice attack; and microbiologically influenced corrosion. Temperature, salinity, gases, oxygen and microbiology must be assessed together. Numerical temperature/rate generalisations in the source are not universal design rules.
